checks.name: rowfault/clean_steps_name_nothing
checks.rule: a step whose router rows all named experts names no row

checks.name: rowfault/forward/names_the_poisoned_call
checks.rule: the poisoned call's rows named, the other call's none

checks.name: rowfault/forward/other_call_keeps_its_bytes
checks.rule: the clean call's last-row logits beside the poisoned call are its clean run's bytes

checks.name: rowfault/batch/names_the_poisoned_row
checks.rule: row 1 of the batched call named, row 0 not (and the clean prefills before it named nothing)

checks.name: rowfault/batch/other_row_keeps_its_bytes
checks.rule: row 0's logits beside the poisoned row are its clean run's bytes

checks.name: rowfault/batch/other_row_next_step_keeps_its_bytes
checks.rule: row 0's next step, alone, is its clean run's bytes and names nothing

checks.name: rowfault/unnamed_flag_fails_the_step
checks.rule: a call flag no row map explains fails the step
checks.extra: Err("route: a router row selected an expert outside the model's (a non-finite router row) and no call's row map names it")
